description: A large, bulky, scaly dinosaur with a broad beaked snout stands in a murky marsh at dusk, tilted forward and reaching up to nibble a branch of conifer. Its body is brown-gold with a row of small spines along the back and tail. Behind it are a grey, stormy sky, still water, a low hazy shoreline, ferns and conifers, and driftwood in the foreground. The image fills the edge to edge, with no frame, text or people.
